## Project Overview: AI Consultant Tank Simulator (CEP)

This page serves as a portal for our **Tarkington Business Futures Institute** Culminating Experience Project (**CEP Group 8**, advised by **Dr. Lin**), examining **AI consultant tank simulation** and **synthetic AI respondent validity compared to human benchmarks**, alongside **Case 31** analytics workflows.

## Key Metrics & Structure

| Workstream | Focus | Status / Next Step |
|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **CEP Simulator** | Synthetic AI respondent validity vs. human benchmarks | Proposal & simulation metrics in progress |
| **Case 31 Pipeline** | Data preparation, measurement model, & hypothesis summaries | Structured analysis tables & Quarto reporting |
| **Dashboard Portal** | KPI & validity comparison overview | Ready to expand with live data/charts |

```{r}
#| label: setup-check 
#| #| message: false

library(tibble) 
library(gt)

portal_summary |> gt() |> tab_header(title = "Portal Deliverable Snapshot")
```
